title: Don't Practice Alone
subtitle: Four free tools that turn interview anxiety into muscle memory
intro: You saved a post that said interview prep feels harder until you find the right tools. It listed four you wish you knew earlier.
takeaway: Practice interviews like performances: rehearse with people, frameworks, and feedback before the real stage.

sections.heading: Analogy: Dress rehearsal before opening night
sections.body:
Think of a tech interview like a live show. You wouldn't open on Broadway without rehearsals.

Pramp is your rehearsal partner, Google Warmup is your voice coach, Exponent shows you the script from ex-FAANG directors, and InterviewBit is your daily scales. That setup leads to why these tools exist.

sections.heading: Why does this exist? Practice you can't get from books
sections.body:
Books can't give you nerves, timing, or feedback. These tools can.

- Pramp matches you with peers for live mock coding sessions with instant feedback
- Exponent gives video lessons and frameworks from ex-FAANG interviewers with real questions
- Google Interview Warmup uses AI to check your spoken answers

But tools alone don't guarantee a job, which is what can break.

sections.heading: What can go wrong? Rehearsing the wrong play
sections.body:
If you only grind InterviewBit problems but never speak out loud, you freeze on Google Warmup.

If you only watch Exponent without peer pressure from Pramp, you miss timing and nerves. Use all four in a loop: learn, code, speak, perform with a human.

steps.narration: Start with Exponent to learn how FAANG interviewers think.
Drill the pattern on InterviewBit until it's automatic.
Say your approach aloud and get AI feedback on Google Warmup.
Test it live with a peer on Pramp under real pressure.
Use feedback to fix one thing and loop again.

quiz.q: What does Pramp give you that the other three don't?
options: Live mock sessions with a real peer and instant feedback
AI analysis of your spoken voice
quiz.why: The save says Pramp matches you with peers for live mock coding sessions with instant feedback.

quiz.q: What breaks first if you only watch Exponent videos and never use Pramp or Warmup?
options: You will know frameworks but freeze when you must code and speak under pressure
You will run out of coding problems to practice
Google Warmup will delete your account
quiz.why: Watching without speaking or performing live misses timing, nerves, and feedback - so you fail in the real interview.

quiz.q: When should you use Google Interview Warmup?
options: To practice common interview questions and get AI speech feedback
To get matched for peer coding mocks
quiz.why: The save describes it as Google's free AI tool that lets you practice common interview questions with voice feedback.
